{{Quote|The Exchange is using an old Reclamation base as an ammo stockyard. We've taken two shots at it now, and we may have to cut our losses and retreat.|[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Tremont]]|<ref name="TOR:CDtT">{{TORcite|type=heroic|Call Down the Thunder|Tatooine}}</ref>}}
A '''base''' originally used by the [[Imperial Reclamation Service]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] in the [[Jundland Wastes/Legends|Jundland Wastes]], on the planet [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], became the headquarters of the [[Exchange]] in this region and a hub for [[Spice/Legends|spice]] traffic.

==Description==
{{Quote|The soldiers here, they've been on Tatooine too long. Going native. Sloth, larceny, disrespect for the Imperial code... [...] It's spice that does it to them. The spice the Exchange has been dealing our soldiers despite my best efforts.|Captain [[Charles Reskin]]|<ref name="TOR:WoS">{{TORcite|type=heroic|War on Spice|Tatooine}}</ref>}}
The base was located in the [[Southern Jundland Wastes]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], set atop the ridge formed by [[Scrap Ridge]] and the [[Red Cliff]].<ref name="TOR:RP">{{TORcite|type=faction|Imperial|Rogue Processes|Tatooine}}</ref> The complex included several smaller buildings below in a nearby valley, including an outpost<ref name="TOR:EO">{{TORcite|type=bonus|Enforcing Order|Tatooine}}</ref> and a barracks building.<ref name="TOR:TS" />

The base was used by the Exchange to store [[Spice/Legends|spice]]<ref name="TOR:WoS" /> and ammo.<ref name="TOR:TS" />

==History==
{{Quote|I got a bead on the Exchange's shipping warehouse. The locus of their whole operation. I want to scrape them off the map. But it's guarded by anti-air guns and comm jammers that make a large-scale attack impossible to coordinate.|Captain [[Vuk Dimitrius]]|<ref name="TOR:CDtT" />}}
By [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="TO">{{TOR_dates|1}}</ref> the base had been abandoned by the Empire and taken over by the [[Exchange]] crime syndicate.<ref name="TOR:TS" /> [[Sindal Reed]] led the local thugs from the spice warehouse next to the main building,<ref name="TOR:WoS" /> whereas [[Kiregan Freem]] managed the main warehouse where the anti-air turrets were positioned.<ref name="TOR:CDtT" />

It was later retaken by the Empire on behalf of [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Vuk Dimitrius]] who sent in reinforcements from [[Imperial Infantry Division 130]] to seize the outpost, intentionally keeping the anti-air turrets intact for when they moved in after the death of Kiregan Freem to a team of Imperial volunteers.<ref name="TOR:CDtT" />
